# Fit

> Resize photos for Instagram, YouTube and X in the browser. Exact pixels, presets, batch ZIP.

The public origin is https://fit-local-six.vercel.app. Operated by Ultimatum. Contact ultaultimatum@gmail.com.

## Tools

* [Resize](https://fit-local-six.vercel.app) — Exact pixels in this tab.

## Guides

* [How to resize](https://fit-local-six.vercel.app/guide) — Fill / Fit / Stretch.
* [Print](https://fit-local-six.vercel.app/print) — DPI is not a social preset.
* [Presets](https://fit-local-six.vercel.app/presets) — Instagram, YouTube, X.
* [Instagram](https://fit-local-six.vercel.app/instagram) — Feed vs story vs reel poster.
* [YouTube](https://fit-local-six.vercel.app/youtube) — Thumbnail 1280×720.
* [Avatar](https://fit-local-six.vercel.app/avatar) — Square crop.
* [Modes](https://fit-local-six.vercel.app/modes) — Fill vs Fit vs Stretch.
* [Use cases](https://fit-local-six.vercel.app/use-cases) — What to pick.
* [FAQ](https://fit-local-six.vercel.app/faq) — Privacy.

* Bytes stay in the tab. There is no conversion API and no `/blogs/` cluster.
